user.title: Hikvision AX PRO (Cloud)
user.description: Enter your Hik-Connect account credentials (the same you use in the app). Works both for panels you own and panels shared with you.

select_panel.title: Choose the panel
select_panel.description: Several devices were found on this account: choose the alarm panel to add. Repeat the setup to add another one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Hik-Connect cloud. Check the logs for details.
error.no_panels: No devices found on this Hik-Connect account.

abort.panel_not_accessible: The panel was found but its alarm functions are not accessible with this account (check the user permissions in the Hik-Connect app, and the logs).

data_description.code: Asked by Home Assistant before disarming. Leave empty for no code. It is not the panel's keypad code.
data_description.arm_home: Adds the Stay arming button (zones configured as 'stay' on the panel stay off).
